title: Composio User API key (uak_): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix: UAK_ vs the documented lower-case uak_ and prefix: uak- in place of uak_. Twin of "Composio User API key (uak_): must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of composio-user-api-key-json-api-key: prefix: uak- in place of uak_. Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
